Name: Beds and TVs What More do You Need
Author: BrutalCleric
Description:
This mod adds:

9 new Beds
5 new Windows
3 new TV's
Both Catalogs.
1 fireplace taken from Sundrop City ( [Sundrop City at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4014)
... Was given permission from creators.

I was tired of using the beds in game. Wanted more colorful and  more modern furniture.  Also wanted flat screen TV's from the start of game.  Didn't like how all the TV's in the game just sat right on the floor, so I added stands.

I updated several if not all the windows. Wanted large, sunny windows.

Recolored/brightened up the movie posters.

Mod requires **Content Patcher** ([Content Patcher at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.

**_Issues_**

So far, I haven't found any mods that conflict with this mod.  If you have **Multiple Spouses** ([Multiple Spouses at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6227))  Make sure to go into its config file and change  Bed width to 3.  If not, your bed will be 8 tiles wide.
